subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should this issue stay behind maintainer live-reproduction proof before any repair PR, or should it be narrowed to the already-tracked Claude CLI 401 re-auth guidance work?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the decisive failure depends on a real macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth environment and the related PRs only improve failure guidance rather than proving the managed-spawn root cause.

options.title: Keep Live-Repro Gate
options.body: Run the managed gateway/cron and same-service replay comparison before changing auth env, MCP, or credential-sync behavior.

options.title: Narrow To Re-Auth Hint Work
options.body: Treat only the expired-token 401 user guidance as actionable and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97553 plus its candidate PRs own that narrower behavior.

options.title: Queue Source-Only Repair
options.body: Allow an automated repair attempt from source inspection alone, accepting the risk that it changes the wrong auth boundary without reproducing the service-context failure.

recommendation.title: Keep Live-Repro Gate
recommendation.body: Run the managed gateway/cron and same-service replay comparison before changing auth env, MCP, or credential-sync behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest history across Claude CLI backend defaults, auth env hardening, credential readers, and runtime refactors relevant to the proof choice.
